runners_data.name: Triumph
runners_data.note: Lightly raced with strong stable connections but unknown pace preference makes tactical positioning crucial first time out.

runners_data.name: Always Blue
runners_data.note: Harriet Bethell's excellent recent strike rate with small string suggests this newcomer arrives ready despite inexperience.

runners_data.name: Romance Spirit
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist with proven form level who needs strong pace to be effective from her preferred rear position.

runners_data.name: Miss Malone To You
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning from long break with concerning tendency to fade in the final furlong when pressure applied.

runners_data.name: Mudita
runners_data.note: Another hold-up performer who showed promise last time but needs the race to develop into a genuine test of stamina.

runners_data.name: Exquisite Skye
runners_data.note: Natural front runner whose recent form suggests she can handle this longer trip and control fractions effectively.

races.paceDynamic: Exquisite Skye will control this race from the front with no obvious challengers for the early lead in a small field of six. With most runners (Romance Spirit, Miss Malone To You, Mudita) preferring to sit back and the two unknowns (Triumph, Always Blue) unlikely to show early pace on debut, Exquisite Skye can dictate comfortable fractions. The lack of pace pressure creates a tactical race where the front runner can kick clear while hold-up horses face the challenge of making up significant ground. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and front runners who can control the tempo.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Exquisite Skye Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Exquisite Skye gets uncontested lead and sensible fractions
scenarios.body: She can dictate comfortable splits and kick clear when the field comes under pressure. The lack of early pace means she faces minimal pressure until too late for closers to respond effectively.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely slow and bunched finish develops
scenarios.body: Romance Spirit or Mudita can unleash superior finishing kicks in a sprint finish. Their higher ratings and proven form give them the edge in a tactical battle where class tells.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Unknown Debut Winner
scenarios.trigger: If Triumph or Always Blue show unexpected early speed or finishing kick
scenarios.body: The lightly raced newcomers possess superior breeding and stable strength that translates to immediate success. Their fresh legs and potential improvement curve overcomes the experience of exposed rivals.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Exquisite Skye goes too slowly and field crawls to halfway
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint where the fittest and most talented horse wins regardless of position. Miss Malone To You's tendency to fade works against her while stronger finishers benefit.

watchPoints.text: Exquisite Skye setting crawling early pace that becomes impossible for hold-up horses to overcome in time
Romance Spirit getting too far back early as small field and slow pace could leave her with too much ground to make up
Triumph or Always Blue showing unexpected pace positions that could signal superior ability on debut
Miss Malone To You's finishing effort after long layoff and whether stamina holds over this extended trip
Darragh Keenan's tactical ride on Exquisite Skye and whether he allows her natural front-running instincts to take over

races.name: Visit attheraces.com Handicap

runners_data.name: Diamand De Vindecy
runners_data.note: Classy hold-up horse returning from long break under Luke Morris, needs pace collapse to be effective from rear.

runners_data.name: No More Bolero
runners_data.note: Only true front-runner with recent winning form, perfectly placed to control race from flag-fall with Mason Paetel's claiming allowance.

runners_data.name: Zimmerman
runners_data.note: Prominent runner for in-form Tim Easterby but long absence since August and inconsistent recent efforts are concerns.

runners_data.name: Rupert The Prince
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent performer but massive 198-day break and question marks over stamina at this extended trip.

runners_data.name: Treasure Islands
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with poor recent form, needs everything to fall right from the back but David Allan booking catches the eye.

runners_data.name: Stitching Wheel
runners_data.note: Lightweight hold-up performer with modest ability, faces impossible task from rear against this quality.

races.paceDynamic: No More Bolero stands alone as the clear pace-setter with his prominent style and recent winning form, likely to dictate terms from the front without pressure. Zimmerman and Rupert The Prince may sit close but lack the tactical speed to challenge early, while the hold-up quartet of Tarbat Ness, Diamand De Vindecy, Treasure Islands and Stitching Wheel will be relying on the pace to collapse. With only one true front-runner in a small field, No More Bolero can control the gallop and kick when ready. This race shape strongly favours the pace-setter and prominent runners who can track the lone leader.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If No More Bolero sets moderate fractions without pressure from the prominent runners
scenarios.body: The lone leader can dictate ideal splits and have plenty left for the finish, while the hold-up horses face an impossible task from too far back. This tactical advantage combined with his recent winning form makes him very hard to peg back.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Hold-Up Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too conservative and the field bunches up entering the final half-mile
scenarios.body: Tarbat Ness and Diamand De Vindecy can use their proven stamina and closing kicks to sweep past tiring leaders. The compressed finish allows their superior turn of foot to be decisive in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Zimmerman or Rupert The Prince can sit close enough to pounce when No More Bolero comes under pressure
scenarios.body: The Easterby-trained Zimmerman has the class edge on ratings while Rupert The Prince brings solid recent form despite the long break. Either can capitalize if perfectly positioned behind the leader.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If No More Bolero goes too fast early trying to build an unassailable lead
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where any of the hold-up horses can get involved, but this requires the leader to make a significant tactical error. Treasure Islands or Stitching Wheel could benefit from the chaos.

watchPoints.text: No More Bolero's early positioning - if he doesn't lead cleanly from the start, the entire race dynamic changes
Zimmerman's fitness after 196 days off - any signs of rustiness will end his chances of tracking the leader
The pace through the first mile - if it's crawling, the hold-up horses get a massive tactical boost
Rupert The Prince's stamina at this trip after long break - needs to prove he can last home over two miles
Tarbat Ness settling in behind - must not get too far back given the lack of early pace

runners_data.name: Stressfree

runners_data.name: Prince Of The Seas
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with good record on similar going and effective at this distance when fresh

runners_data.name: Ashnak
runners_data.note: Prominent style fits race shape perfectly and recent second at Pontefract suggests current form is solid

runners_data.name: Dancingwithmyself

races.paceDynamic: Prydwen will take the field along from the front with Prince Of The Seas and Ashnak tracking close behind in prominent positions. The pace will be genuine but not overly strong given limited early speed, allowing the front rank to dictate terms through steady fractions. Hold-up horses Stressfree, Dancingwithmyself and Gibside face a tactical disadvantage as they'll need the pace to collapse late over this stamina-testing trip. This race shape clearly favours prominent runners who can sit close to the pace and have something left for the finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prydwen Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Prydwen gets an uncontested lead and maintains a strong gallop
scenarios.body: The 8-year-old's stamina tells late as he kicks clear turning for home, with Prince Of The Seas tracking him into second. Hold-up horses find too much to do against the sustained pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Prince Of The Seas or Ashnak press Prydwen early and create more pace
scenarios.body: The increased tempo suits the fresher legs of Prince Of The Seas who strikes late, with Ashnak staying on strongly for the places. The stronger pace stretches the field and exposes stamina limitations.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Charge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is slower than expected and the leaders come back
scenarios.body: Dancingwithmyself and Stressfree benefit from the lack of early pace to mount late challenges. The hold-up horses find the gaps and superior finishing speed tells.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If the race develops into a sprint finish with multiple chances
scenarios.body: Gibside's light weight and recent proximity to better horses helps him outfinish rivals who've done too much work early. The low-weighted runner benefits from a messy pace scenario.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Prydwen gets a soft early lead as his stamina advantage could prove decisive in a small field
Monitor the early pace set by prominent runners Prince Of The Seas and Ashnak as excessive pressure could set up hold-up horses
Observe Stressfree's early positioning after the long break as fitness concerns may force connections into more aggressive tactics
Check if Dancingwithmyself can secure a clear run from his hold-up position as traffic problems often occur in small fields

races.paceDynamic: Seven Questions will lead this field as the only confirmed front runner, likely setting a sustainable pace without early pressure. Copper Knight, Castan, and Equity Law will track prominently behind the leader, while the hold-up quartet of Dream Composer, Dyonisos, Tiva, and Vince L'Amour will settle at the back. With most of the field sitting off the pace, Seven Questions faces minimal early pressure, creating a tempo that will suit prominent racers who can position close enough to strike when the pace lifts in the final furlong. This race shape strongly favors prominent runners who can sit handy and respond when required.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Suits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Seven Questions maintains control without being hassled early
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader sets ideal fractions for those tracking close, with prominent runners perfectly positioned to strike in the straight. Hold-up horses face too much ground to make up against the controlled tempo.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Sprint Develops Late Kick
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly crawling through halfway
scenarios.body: The race becomes a dash from the 2f pole, suiting the fresher hold-up horses who can produce their best turn of foot. Dyonisos and Tiva benefit from their recent runs and closing style.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Capitulates
scenarios.trigger: If Seven Questions goes too fast or ties up in the final furlong
scenarios.body: Copper Knight and Castan, sitting in the perfect stalking positions, inherit the lead as the pace collapses. Their prominent style allows them to capitalize immediately on the leader's demise.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If no horse wants to go forward and the tempo becomes suicidal
scenarios.body: The entire field bunches up creating a cavalry charge finish that becomes a pure lottery. Any horse with a clear run and late momentum can prevail regardless of early positioning.

watchPoints.text: Seven Questions setting uncontested fractions - if allowed an easy lead, will be very hard to peg back in this company

How much pace pressure Seven Questions faces in the first two furlongs - any early hassling completely changes the race dynamics

races.paceDynamic: Highland Olly and The Sweet Escape will contest the early lead, with Highland Olly showing more recent front-running success and likely to establish control. Both prominent runners Poet's Dawn and Hostility will track close behind, keeping the pace honest but not frantic over this testing mile. The presence of multiple hold-up horses including Up The Jazz, Keats House, Ravishing Beauty, and Amidst The Chaos suggests a bunched finish is likely. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can sit handy and kick, as the leaders may tire and the hold-up horses will need perfect splits in a large field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Highland Olly or The Sweet Escape establish a controlled lead without going too fast early
scenarios.body: The pace will be steady enough for those tracking in behind to strike, with the leaders coming back to the field in the final two furlongs. Poet's Dawn and Hostility are perfectly positioned to capitalize from their prominent positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Challenge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is strong enough to set up the race for closers
scenarios.body: The front two will duel too hard early, creating gaps for the patient hold-up horses to exploit with late runs. Up The Jazz and Keats House have the class to capitalize if they get clear runs.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Highland Olly gets an uncontested lead and dictates steady fractions
scenarios.body: The recent winner will have enough left in the tank to repel all challenges, using his proven front-running ability on good ground. His solid recent form gives him the edge over The Sweet Escape in a straight fight.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too slow and it becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race will turn into a cavalry charge with the entire field having chances in the final furlong. This chaos scenario could throw up a surprise winner from the back markers with the best turn of foot.

watchPoints.text: Highland Olly could get an easy lead if The Sweet Escape doesn't show early pace, making him very dangerous

races.paceDynamic: Blue Nguru and Vencedora will lead from the gates, with Arishka's Dream, Koffee And Kale, and Contorno pressing close behind in the opening furlongs. This creates genuine pace pressure early, likely setting up an honest gallop through halfway before the inevitable 6f sprint finish. The heavy contingent of hold-up horses (Ecclefechan, Siouxpersonic, Solar Cooper, Liverpool Star, Hares Bredth) suggests the pace will be testing enough to bring late runners into play. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and hold-up horses who can finish, with pure front-runners facing a tough task to sustain their efforts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong early pace collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Blue Nguru and Vencedora duel too hard through the first half-mile
scenarios.body: The pace burns out both leaders, creating perfect conditions for the closers to sweep up from the back. Hold-up horses with proven finishing kicks will dominate the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical moderate gallop
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runners settle into a more sensible rhythm after initial sparring
scenarios.body: This allows prominent racers to track the pace comfortably and kick clear before the hold-up brigade can organize their challenge. Those handy to the pace throughout will prove hardest to peg back.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Sustained honest pace
scenarios.trigger: If Blue Nguru or Vencedora manages to string out the field with relentless galloping
scenarios.body: The pace stays strong but not suicidal, favoring horses with tactical speed who can position well and still finish. Mid-race positioning becomes crucial in a truly-run contest.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front-runner dominance
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders gets an easy time up front due to the other pulling or racing keenly
scenarios.body: The lack of pressure allows the survivor to build an unassailable lead, making life difficult for all behind. Late runners face an impossible task against a horse with energy reserves intact.

watchPoints.text: Blue Nguru could struggle with fitness on seasonal return after 129 days off, particularly if forced into early speed duel
Koffee And Kale and Siouxpersonic both face fitness questions after 200+ day absences despite capable form when last seen
Contorno's recent win at Lingfield suggests improved form and Sean Bowen's booking indicates live chances
Solar Cooper faces a tough task from his likely poor early position given the abundance of natural pace in this field
Arishka's Dream looks the most straightforward proposition given recent consistent form and suitable racing style
